Could you send Denis a note confirming you're happy with these? He can then initial them, and I'll get them signed. Many thanks, Richard

The only changes I've made are these:

Announcements: Any announcement related to this agreement has to be approved in advance, in writing, by both parties.

Information Sharing: Provided the individual marketplace participant authorizes it, i2 may, at a minimum, share the following details for everyone who views EnronCredit.com information:
- First and last name
- Company name
- Job title
- Email address
- Business address
- Telephone number
